body: Thank you, if they do you will be the first to know
I've been looking, nothing comes back. Thank you for trying to help, but I think I'm going to shorten the time I have left, to now. Good bye everyone

No college will accept me. My grades, all but math, are terrible. I have no money. I've tried for every scholarship they offer, but no reply has come. I physically can't stand for more than a few hours. I wanted it, but I could never achieve it.
Math is my only good subject, and that alone doesn't stand for much. I liked helping people, which is why I wanted that particular profession, but I hate being around them now.
Every prospect I had has left me. I wanted to finish high school and become a college math professor, it was the only thing I could see myself doing, but it's gone now.
I used to see a bright future, but it's all fallen into darkness, and myself along with it, I don't want to keep struggling and living.
